legend: Schematic illustration of TCF3::PBX1 fusion, and the functional domains and breakpoints. The dotted red line indicates the breakpoint, and the numbers denote amino acids {12700034}. AD, activation domain; bHLH, basic helix-loop-helix domain; HD, homeodomain.

legend: Sequencing reads obtained after PCR amplification and next-generation sequencing of the <em>TCF3</em>::<em>PBX1</em> fusion junction using cDNA obtained from leukaemia cells. The presence of chimeric reads with sequence from <em>TCF3</em> exon 16 and <em>PBX1</em> exon 3 confirms the presence of the abnormal <em>TCF3</em>::<em>PBX1</em> fusion in the leukaemic clone.
source: Gordana Raca, MD, PhD, FACMG, Director, Clinical Cytogenomics Laboratory, Center for Personalized Medicine, Children’s Hospital Los Angeles, Los Angeles, CA.
